Toronto

Man in his 60s critically injured following stabbing at east end Toronto apartment

By
Alex Arsenych
Opens in new window

Published: February 27, 2026 at 9:16AM EST

A male victim has serious, life-threatening injuries following a stabbing at an apartment in Toronto’s east end on Friday morning, paramedics say.

The incident happened just before 8:30 a.m. in the area of Queen Street East and Logan Avenue.

Police confirmed the victim is in his 60s, and that they had arrested a woman in her 30s.

The circumstances surrounding the incident and the relationship between the victim and suspect are unclear at this time.

This is a developing story. More details to come...
